scripts.check: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 check
scripts.ready: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 check && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 test && vp exec playwright test --workers=1
scripts.test: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 test
scripts.test:e2e: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 2 build && vp exec playwright test --workers=1
